description: Canonical autoctx command contract for Python and TypeScript parity. Version 2 adds positionals, option defaults and constraints, output modes and schemas, stream routing, exit codes, and canonical examples. Loaders retain defaults for version-1 command entries while commands migrate incrementally; export is the first fully specified v2 conformance slice.

commands.summary: Take a natural-language objective, generate or select a scenario, run iterations against a real evaluator, and export the learned approach.

flags.name: iterations
flags.description: Number of refinement rounds. Canonical name across both runtimes. Legacy aliases (--gens, --rounds, --max-iterations) are tracked in AC-697 follow-up slices that add alias plumbing; the contract documents only honored options today.

flags.name: description
flags.description: Plain-language goal. The positional form (`autoctx solve "goal"`) is canonical shorthand.

commands.summary: Execute a saved scenario for one or more iterations and produce a Run artifact.

flags.name: iterations
flags.description: Number of generations to execute. Canonical name across both runtimes. Legacy aliases (--gens, --rounds) are tracked in AC-697 follow-up slices.

flags.name: run-id
flags.description: Operator-chosen run identifier. Generated if omitted.

commands.summary: Show run status for the given <run-id>. Canonical meaning is RUN status; queue status lives under `queue status`.

positionals.name: run-id
positionals.description: Run to inspect; required unless the named --run-id form is supplied. Queue status is available only through `autoctx queue status`.

flags.name: run-id
flags.description: Named alternative to the run-id positional.

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit one structured JSON value.

commands.summary: Stream live updates for an in-flight run.
Render a human-readable view of a finished run's artifacts (best strategy, scores, playbook).

flags.name: best
flags.description: Show only the best-scoring generation. Demo / agent-friendly.

commands.summary: Export a Run's learned knowledge as a portable JSON package or Pi-package directory.

positionals.name: run-id
positionals.description: Run whose learned knowledge should be exported. Omit when --scenario is supplied.

flags.name: format
flags.description: Artifact format. Use json for the portable strategy package or pi-package for a local Pi package directory; strategy remains a deprecated alias for json.

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Scenario whose accumulated knowledge should be exported.

flags.name: run-id
flags.description: Named form of the optional run-id positional.

flags.name: output
flags.description: Destination JSON file or Pi-package directory. JSON is written to stdout when omitted; Pi packages use <scenario>-pi-package.

flags.name: json
flags.description: Emit a structured receipt when an artifact is written to a file or directory.

commands.summary: List recent runs.
Replay a stored generation from a run.
Score a single agent output against a rubric.
Run an evaluate-revise improvement loop against a rubric.
Manage the task queue. Subcommands cover add / status / list.
Show queue pending / in-flight counts. Distinct from top-level `status` (which is run status).
Materialize a new scenario from a description, template, or harness spec.
Long-running verified-goal mission manager (create / run / list).
Start the HTTP API + WebSocket server.
Start the MCP server on stdio. Canonical path is `serve mcp`; legacy single-token `mcp-serve` is kept as a registered alias on both runtimes.
Enumerate canonical commands, aliases, and per-runtime support. Operator-facing surface for the AC-697 contract.
List evaluator-epoch registry records (candidate/active/disabled) and their promotion metadata as JSON.

commands.summary: Re-score a run's stale generations under the current evaluator and report drift; read-only unless --apply, which appends audit revisions without changing the live score.

typescript.reason: on-demand re-score depends on the Python-only LLM-judge and evaluator-epoch registry path; no TypeScript equivalent (matches the epoch CLI).

flags.name: generation
flags.description: Re-score a single generation by index (default: all stale generations).

flags.name: apply
flags.description: Promote matching active-epoch re-scores onto the generation and clear quarantine, archiving the original.

flags.name: by
flags.description: Reviewer identity recorded on applied revisions.
